title: Deutsch-Jozsa Global Property Evaluation
question: Explain how phase kickback allows the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm to evaluate global properties of f(x) in a single quantum query.

rubricCriteria.criterion: Quantum superposition & target qubit initialization in |−⟩

sampleSolution: By placing the target ancillary qubit in the minus state |-> = (|0> - |1>)/sqrt(2), evaluating the oracle U_f |x>|-> yields (-1)^f(x) |x>|->, kicking the function value into the relative phase of the input register.
